# ADR-0001

Use the IWARD Architecture

## Status

Accepted.

## Decision

The project shall be organised into five conceptual layers:

- Ingestion

- Wrangling

- Analysis

- Reporting

- Documentation

Each layer has a single responsibility.

Dependencies are permitted only from higher layers to lower layers.

No function may cross a layer boundary.

## Consequences

### Advantages

High cohesion. Low coupling. Excellent testability. Clear ownership of responsibilities.

### Trade-offs

Slightly more boilerplate. More objects.

Accepted because maintainability is preferred over brevity.
